quote.exact: Geant4 Application for Tomographic Emission (GATE) v9.1 was used to perform the simulations
Each module is a 50 × 50 × 16 ­mm3 monolithic LYSO crystal
Both designs consist of 40 detector modules per ring, resulting in a bore diameter of 70 cm
Scanner designs A and B have an aFOV of 36.2 cm (7 rings) and 72.6 cm (14 rings)

annotations.note: Design A 36.2 cm aFOV (7 rings), design B 72.6 cm (14 rings)

quote.exact: the values for the point sources were below 2 mm for the radial, tangential, and axial full width half maximum

annotations.note: Point-source FWHM below 2 mm radial, tangential and axial

quote.exact: The sensitivity of design A was calculated to be 29.2 kcps/MBq at the centre
the sensitivity of design B was found to be 106.8 kcps/MBq
The peaks NECR are 716 kcps for design A and 1235 kcps for design B
The calculated scatter fraction is 32% for both designs
The scanners were modelled with a 200 ps CTR
The FWHM values show a flat sub-2 mm spatial resolution across the axial/transverse FOV

annotations.note: Flat sub-2 mm resolution across the FOV
